paragraphs.source_en: I ask for horses and weapons and matches. He agrees curtly and turns to leave before I can ask him one last question. I grab his arm as he starts to ascend. Something happens. I grab his arm as he starts to ascend.
Something happens.
My nerves fry.
Like needles in acid through my hand and arm.
I gasp.
My lungs can’t function for a second.

paragraphs.source_en: “Gory hell,” I cough out, and fall to the ground. He wears pulseArmor. I can’t even see the generator. It’s like a pulseShield, but inlaid in the armor itself.

paragraphs.source_en: Large horses graze in the fields the next morning. Wolves try to take down a small mare. A pale stallion rides up and kicks one of the wolves to death. I claim him. The others call him Quietus. It means “the final stroke.”
